title: Vermifuge
summary: VERM'IFUGE, noun [Latin vermis, a worm, and fugo, to expel.] A medicine or substance that destroys or expels worms from animal bodies; an anthelmintic.

inlines.v: VERM'IFUGE, noun [Latin vermis, a worm, and fugo, to expel.] A medicine or substance that destroys or expels worms from animal bodies; an anthelmintic.
